label: Mock practice paper
source: CL school mock Set 3 Question 1 Part B (乙部); not HKEAA
title: Creation skeleton (from Set 3 Question 1 Part B)
themePrompt: Make a two-dimensional work on Advancing in the Wind. Transform Part A visual language (pressing scale / speed; tiny advance / steam-light; solid–void layers) into a personal statement about journey, weather or historical change.
mediaConstraints: Any 2D medium (ink, watercolour, acrylic, mixed media, etc.)
Must remain a flat/two-dimensional work (Paper 1 Part B requirement)
Encourage visible wind/rain/vapour atmosphere and a sense of advance or journey

checklist.text: Composition shows a clear path of movement or scale tension (e.g. diagonal advance, pressing distance vs near figure).
Medium supports the idea (e.g. dense dots/short cun in distance; slanted washes or flying white in foreground).
Theme Advancing in the Wind is readable in the image, not only in the title.
Sketches/process notes are included with transfer points from Part A.
~50-word artist statement links intent to Part A criticism.
At least one visual idea is explicitly transferred from plate (1a) or (1b).

aiPolicy.note: Under 18 or age not confirmed: use this checklist only — no AI trial marking.
